title: Guest Service Fee Refund on an Approved Travel Issue — Stays (Guest Reservations)
content:
# Guest service fee refund on an approved travel issue — policy statement and tool reference

## Policy statement

On an approved travel issue on a reservation in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category, Roamhaven refunds its guest service fee as a percentage of the travel-issue fee base and pays it to the guest's original payment method, while the occupancy tax of a travel issue is refunded in the proportion that the refunded nightly and cleaning amounts bear to their full amounts. The service-fee refund of a travel issue is fixed only after the stay's ledger carries the nightly refund of that travel issue.

Read against the stay's ledger: as long as it does not show the nightly refund of the travel issue, the service-fee refund of that travel issue is not fixed.

## Issuing the travel-issue service-fee refund — `refund_travel_service_fee_041715de`

**Situation of use and capability.** Issue the part of Roamhaven's guest service fee that is refunded on an approved travel-issue request, to the guest's original payment method. One call records one refund on the stay's money ledger for the charge component, reason, request, funding side, payout stage and amount given; the refund then shows on the stay and reaches the guest's card within the card issuer's posting time. The receipt confirms the refund.

**How it is invoked.** `refund_travel_service_fee_041715de` is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | What it is | Format and values |
|---|---|---|
| `stay_id` | the reference number of the stay (reservation) whose travel-issue service-fee refund is booked, as returned by the stay lookup for the guest | identifier |
| `charge_component` | the charge component the refund is booked against | one of `nightly` (the price of the stay's nights), `cleaning_fee` (the cleaning fee, or short-stay cleaning fee, charged on the stay), `pet_fee` (the pet fee charged on the stay), `extra_guest_fee` (the fee charged for guests above the listing's included guest count), `guest_service_fee` (Roamhaven's guest service fee), `occupancy_tax` (the occupancy tax charged on the stay), `none` (only for a record that refunds no charge component, which a refund never is) |
| `refund_reason` | why the refund is issued | one of `guest_cancellation` (it rests on the guest cancelling the stay), `host_cancellation` (the host cancelled the stay), `alteration` (an accepted date or guest-count change lowered the price), `travel_issue` (it rests on an approved travel-issue request), `major_disruptive_event` (it rests on an approved major-disruptive-event request), `none` (only for a record that is no refund, which this never is) |
| `request_id` | the reference number of the stay request the refund rests on, as returned by the stay request lookup | identifier; an empty value when the refund rests on no request |
| `funded_by` | who bears the refund | one of `host` (it comes out of the host's earnings for the stay), `platform` (Roamhaven bears it), `none` (only for a record that is no refund, which this never is) |
| `refund_stage` | the payout stage of the stay at the moment of the refund | one of `before_payout_release` (no release of the host's earnings for this stay is on record yet), `after_payout_release` (such a release is already on record), `none` (only for a record that is no refund, which this never is) |
| `amount` | the refund | a positive amount in US dollars with 2 decimal places; a value with more decimals is rounded half up to 2 decimal places when booked |

**Return.** A receipt listing `refund_reference` (the reference number of the new refund record), `stay_id`, `charge_component`, `refund_reason`, `amount` (US dollars with 2 decimal places), `funded_by`, `refund_stage`, `posted_at` (the moment the refund was issued, in the form YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS) and a status, which is always "refund_issued" when the refund went out.
